title: Every reason names the failure it is attached to
outcome: No reason constant is paired with a message about a different failure, and none carries two different HTTP meanings, so keying copy by reason cannot put the wrong sentence on screen.
acceptanceCriteria: The protected-field guard in profile.usecase is deleted rather than relabelled. It is unreachable from every caller: the route parses the body with a .strict() schema that admits only activeTeamId, info and preferences, so userId and id are rejected at the boundary; and the one internal caller passes a literal whose type already excludes them. It is dead code left behind when the request schema landed, and the mislabelled reason goes with it.

NOT_INVITED resolves to 404 everywhere. It is thrown as NotFoundError in accept and reject but as ConflictError in cancel, and all three check the same thing — that no pending invitation was found. One reason must not carry two HTTP meanings once a single message is keyed to it.

Every other reason constant is checked against the messages at its construction sites. Two defects of this class have now been found and neither was detectable by any test, so the pass is over all of them rather than over the two already known.
This slice depends on nothing and must land before the copy. It is a prerequisite rather than an adjacent cleanup: the new mechanism turns a latent mislabelling into visible wrong copy.
